_comment: Sample Target_Registry for the Discord-Ollama Coding Agent.
This is the persisted, machine-writable store of Registered_Targets; it survives container restarts.
Copy this file to e.g. target_registry.json and edit it for your targets.
Each target needs: a unique name (1..64 non-whitespace Unicode chars), a directory_path that resolves
INSIDE the configured workspace_dir, and a non-empty repo_remote. Targets missing any of these are
excluded at startup with a logged reason (but startup still proceeds).
build_command is optional (a target with none skips the build step).
default_branch is synced from the remote before each Job (default 'main').
branch_scheme is a naming template; the default '{job_id}' already includes the target name because
credentials_ref is a REFERENCE to the Git credentials (an environment-variable name or a secret path),
NEVER the secret value itself. The secret is resolved at push time and is never persisted or logged.
The agent appends admin-added targets to the real registry file automatically; the '_comment' key
above is ignored by the loader and is only here for documentation.
